objective: Raise the equal-weight five-component proxy of the frozen nine-model blend toward the 0.85 target without degrading any of the other four components beyond the pre-declared guardrails.

official_score.rank: each raw metric is ranked as a percentile over all valid submissions; turnover is ranked in reverse

baseline.description: TLOB + MLPLOB + dual_patch, seeds 11/29/47, fixed 1/9 weight per checkpoint
baseline.package_status: blend weights and nine-member spec frozen at runs/submission-best-20261026/build; the nine-model flat package was not built or checked offline before this protocol
baseline.role: current fixed analysis baseline; supersedes the V3 three-seed TLOB baseline, whose records stay as history

local_approximation.neutralization: previous-trading-day exposure, median +/- 3*1.4826*MAD winsorization, cross-section z-score, equal-weight OLS on 10 style factors and 32 industry dummies
local_approximation.stress: minimum of the pooled high-volatility and high-amount daily rank IC; high/low volatility and high/low amount are defined from the official vwap/amount series with a 20-day rolling median and the 8 sampled clocks
local_approximation.ic: daily Pearson IC of the neutralized score; ic_ir is mean/std(ddof=1), not annualized; sharpe is gross and annualized by sqrt(252); turnover is mean daily 0.5*sum|dw|
local_approximation.reference_panel: fixed 15-arm reference panel: the 16 local arms minus the baseline (9 frozen checkpoints + 6 pairwise equal-weight combinations); the baseline's own percentiles use the same denominator 15, so removing it does not change them. A new candidate is scored against the 15 fixed arms with (worse + 0.5*ties)/15 and is never inserted into the panel.
local_approximation.interpretation: IC, stress and turnover are already above the 0.85 percentile line on the local panel; IC_IR carries the largest positive shortfall (+0.050, larger than the whole +0.037 proxy gap) and Sharpe carries the second (+0.023). The proxy level is not the platform score because the competition field is unobserved; only the ordering is transferable.

comparison_metrics.primary: equal-weight composite of the five component percentiles against the fixed 15-arm reference panel
comparison_metrics.uncertainty: 5-day moving-block bootstrap, 4000 draws, seed 20261026, over the 104 pooled days; each draw recomputes all five components for both arms and their percentiles against the fixed panel; report the 95% interval of the composite difference
comparison_metrics.robustness: the candidate must improve IC_IR in both the screen months (2023-11, 2024-01, 2024-03) and the verify months (2024-04, 2024-06)

promotion_rule.robustness: both screen and verify IC_IR differences positive
promotion_rule.otherwise: retain the nine-model equal blend as the submission baseline

families: fixed convex reweighting of the nine frozen checkpoints, no retraining, weights declared before evaluation
retrained variant with one declared stability change (regime-balanced sampling, month-balanced loss or an equivalent single-factor change) using the same data, recipe and budget as the 20261026 runs
candidate_rule.declaration: the exact weights or training change must be written into a candidate plan before any candidate metric is computed; no post-hoc weight or threshold search
candidate_rule.note: the local panel shows TLOB seeds carry the lowest IC_IR (2.42-2.58) and the equal blend inherits that drag; a MLP+Patch 50:50 reweighting already reaches composite 0.933 in-sample, but it was observed on already-used months and is not promotion evidence by itself

final_check.name: q4_2024_final
final_check.purpose: one-shot verification of the frozen round-5 candidate after all selection is complete; never used for training, weighting, threshold or candidate choice

access_policy: The five development months and the 2023-11 validation window are already-used research data. The 2024-10-08..2025-01-01 final interval stays closed until the candidate is frozen; a final read must be logged in runs/audit.sqlite3 with the stated purpose and is counted against max_views=1. No 2025+ data.

decision.rule: promote the candidate only if the composite proxy is >= 0.85, its 5-day block 95% interval excludes zero, IC_IR improves in both screen and verify months, and all five guardrails hold; otherwise retain the nine-model equal blend

budget.note: wall time, RSS and training steps are fixed in the candidate plan before the run; this protocol itself opens no new data and trains nothing

legacy_caliber.legacy_mark: 旧口径结论——不得用于晋升
legacy_caliber.reason: A1 停止旧评价晋升模型：五项等权百分位代理（16 臂固定面板、0.85 门槛）降级为旧口径，仅作描述性参考，不得作为晋升或淘汰输入
